name: Roamr: Every Mile Mapped
subtitle: GPS tracker: walk, run, drive
promotionalText: New: trips open map first on a night map, History shows a route card for every trip, and the gas log works out your MPG from the drives Roamr records.
description:
Roamr records every way you move: walks, runs, hikes, bike rides and drives. Tap Start, lock your phone and go. Roamr draws your route on a night map and keeps every trip.

TRACK ANYTHING
Distance, time, pace or speed, and climb, live on screen and on the Lock Screen with a Live Activity. Roamr keeps recording in the background and recovers the trip if the app gets closed. Voice splits call out each mile or kilometer.

TRIPS, MAP FIRST
Open any trip and the route fills the screen on a night map, with the key numbers floating on top and splits, speed and details in a sheet you pull up. Switch to day, satellite or hybrid any time.

HISTORY WITH ROUTE CARDS
Every trip gets a card with a snapshot of its route, grouped by week and day with totals. Filter by activity, open a trip in one tap, or make a shareable recap card.

MADE FOR DRIVES TOO
Roamr notices when you start driving and offers to record the drive. On the road you get a big speedometer with the posted speed limit (from OpenStreetMap), and every drive is saved with its start and end streets. Need directions? Search a place and Roamr guides you there turn by turn.

GAS AND MPG LOG
Log each fill-up with gallons and price. Roamr works out your MPG from the odometer or from the drives it recorded between full tanks, and shows what you spend on fuel each month, for each vehicle.

GO TOGETHER
Driving to the trailhead with friends, or running as a group? Start a group trip, send the invite link or join code, and everyone shows up live on one map. Each person's trip still lands in their own history.

STATS AND RECAPS
Weekly totals, personal records and all-time numbers, plus a monthly recap of miles, hours and your longest trip.

YOUR WORKOUTS AND HEART RATE
Roamr reads the workouts and heart rate your watch saves to Apple Health, so a run recorded on your wrist shows up with its heart rate. Your walks and hikes also show up under your tree hugs in Rootbound.

EXPORT
Share any route as a GPX file to the mapping or training app you already use.

APPLE WATCH, WIDGETS AND SIRI
See your live trip on your wrist, start tracking from a widget or Control Center, or ask Siri to start tracking.

FREE AND PRO
Recording every trip, History, Stats, the gas log, directions, the Watch app and joining a friend's group are free. Roamr Pro adds starting group trips and the monthly recap. Choose monthly or yearly (with a free first week for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your trips live on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud. Your position is shared only with the people in a group trip you start or join, and only while it's on.

Watch the road, not your phone: keep your eyes on driving and follow local traffic laws and posted speed limits.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in.

To try it: on the Track tab pick Walk, Run, Hike, Ride or Drive and tap Start. In the Simulator, Features › Location › City Run makes a trip. History and Stats fill in as trips are saved.

Location: When In Use records the trip you start; Always keeps recording while the phone is locked and lets Roamr notice a drive starting so it can offer to record it (it never records without asking). Motion: tells walking, running, biking and driving apart. HealthKit: read-only, workouts and heart rate.

Go together (group trips): start one with the people button on the Track tab (Pro) or join with a code (free). Members' chosen name and live position are exchanged through the app's CloudKit public database only while the group is on.

Speed limits: road data is downloaded from OpenStreetMap in map tiles of about 4 km; no personal data is sent.

Directions: the Directions button on the Track map searches a place and routes with Apple Maps. Gas & MPG (Settings › Gas & MPG): fill-ups are stored like trips; "Use where I am" takes one location fix to find the nearest station with Apple Maps.

Pro: auto-renewable monthly (com.troydunn.roamr.pro.monthly) and yearly (com.troydunn.roamr.pro.yearly), each with a 1-week free trial as Apple's introductory offer, plus the one-time lifetime unlock (com.troydunn.roamr.pro). Settings › Roamr Pro shows the plans with Restore and Manage Subscription.
